status: proposed fixed protocol; independent source review and host allocation required before any fit
mechanism: Four-parameter target-support tilt trained through the actual fixed half joint-minus-departure source increment; every peer message remains frozen.
novelty: Individual-label posterior-estimator training differs from the closed public-total monthly logit shift, endpoint reconstruction, continuous Rome mean calibration and public-conditioned neural losses. It introduces no new public observations.
parent: Exact serialized v80 Jan/Jul vector, CV 289.7627782102906; no official gain claimed.

six_priors.per_outer: Train B -> all raw A peers; train A -> all raw B peers; train A union B -> all raw outer-held peers. No other fit or seed.
six_priors.population: Rome departures. Base supervised labels finite and in [1,200000] seconds; predictions cover every raw row, including VFR and excluded supervised rows. Source/tilt labels are not clipped.
six_priors.family: Source-blind raw 18 clock/category features, 17 fixed-scaled physical scalar inputs, missing flight-ID flag, raw callsign prefix category; 37 total. No public totals, label histories, movement IDs or recorded block endpoint as model features.
six_priors.preprocessing: Category maps learned only from each base fit's supervised training rows; unseen -> missing. Native numeric missing values; fixed physical scaling only. No fitted imputer or global target-derived preprocessing.
six_priors.output: Nonnegative unrounded floating prediction, exact all-row saved-model reload, complete raw ID coverage. No held target enters fit/evaluation callback.

calibration.inner: For each inner prediction bank, all support quantiles/tau and public source calibration use only its base fitting complement. Source records are public; source residual truth is complement-only.
calibration.departure_noise: Replicate daily_offblock_alignment.screen: exclude explicit VFR, assign true_day only during calibration, retain true offblock days interior to each allowed month, then daily_delay_posterior.fit. Never accidentally use default takeoff-day noise.
calibration.support: Replicate original daily_delay_posterior.fit on the original raw training-month population; support tau/spread are separate from offblock noise tau/spread, matching selected joint parameters.
calibration.taxi: Unchanged taxi_count_sum_jan_jul.calibrate: complete local days, valid taxi [0,7200], >=100 source cells and >=100 retained covariance cells, fixed Huber and covariance rule. No threshold relaxation.
calibration.outer: Reuse original audited Jan/Jul taxi/offblock/support parameters, whose allowed months match the all-training prior; no outer calibration refit.
calibration.pre_fit_feasibility: Review then prepare train-only inner calibrations and count gates before any of the six base priors; stop if any fixed complement lacks the original minimum cells.

likelihood.model: Original joint_public_moments normal/discrete support moments and t5 joint/departure likelihoods, fixed original covariance and common-day settings.
likelihood.calendar: UTC takeoff-month inner partitions; all raw peer predictions retained. Once-estimated offblock day from takeoff minus base prediction, then original per-month interior guard. Taxi source local-day cohorts must be complete within the predicted month set, including local midnight boundary handling.
likelihood.no_label_peers: No query or peer held label enters prior, support, calibration, assigned day, group membership or likelihood. Inner-held labels enter only tilt loss after immutable packets exist.
likelihood.tilt: w(theta) proportional to w0 exp((x @ theta)*(support-prior)/max(gap-tau,60)); same target tilt in joint and departure posteriors. Peer supports/covariances and likelihood arrays never change with theta.
likelihood.estimator: D0 + 0.5*(J(theta)-D(theta)), with D0 fixed. This is a discriminative, target-only one-pass approximation, not coherent global joint optimization.
likelihood.derivative: 0.5*(Var_J(theta)-Var_D(theta))/max(gap-tau,60) * x. Gate actual cancellation, magnitude, rank and finite differences; earlier J-only sensitivity is not evidence of incremental gradient.
likelihood.zero_control: Exact same saved supports/messages for all arms; theta=0 reproduces original apply() joint, departure and touched outputs to fixed 1e-8 absolute tolerance. Unchanged outside supported targets.

learning.loss: Mean squared error in units of 3600 seconds plus 0.001*sum(theta**2). Prior arm uses tilted prior mean; posterior arm uses D0+0.5*(Jtheta-Dtheta). Identical supported target set and raw finite y, no clipping or label-based selection.
learning.scope: One four-vector per outer fold, pooled across its two honest inner prediction banks. No optimizer callback reads outer labels. No hyperparameter/feature/seed/weight scan.
learning.failure: Persist optimizer failure and stop; do not silently retry with different settings.

held_evaluation.primary_objective_transport: round_even(max(0, exact_v80 + 0.5*((Jpost-Dpost)-(J0-D0)))) across all 344419 rows; prior-MSE arm uses identical transport; zero delta exactly replays v80.
held_evaluation.family_substitution_diagnostic: Separately report exact_v80 + 0.5*((J0-D0)-(J70-D70)), and the same total substitution for prior/posterior arms. A family substitution gain must not be credited to the objective.
held_evaluation.gate: Primary posterior objective transport improves both months and paired-day bootstrap upper<0 versus exact v80 AND versus identically transported prior-MSE control. Label-blind algebra/source/ID/model reload audits must pass. No scan after outcomes.
held_evaluation.scope_note: This defines an exact additive candidate on serialized v80; it does not claim to replay every historical affine/public correction stage with a different prior. Reused development data do not constitute independent confirmation.
